title: The real cost of running AI models that nobody talks about

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What hidden costs accompany the energy and environmental toll of running large AI models?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Current models use massive GPUs and require cooling, often in energy-intensive data centers.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: This strains global electricity grids and increases carbon footprints, especially in developing regions.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are exploring energy-efficient chips and renewable-powered data centers to reduce impact.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where AI is powered by green energy and designed with sustainability in mind is within reach.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of AI depends not just on innovation, but on the systems that support it.

video_cue: A data center powered by solar panels with AI models running in the background.
